chunks: We created them with definite purpose; but most of them do not understand.

key_terms.بِالْحَقِّ: with the truth / with definite purpose

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by creating things 'with the truth' (bil-haqq)?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Dukhan, this verse emphasizes that the creation of the heavens and the earth was not in vain but established upon 'Al-Haqq' (truth/reality), a concept Shia scholars often link to the divine purpose of establishing the Imamate and guiding humanity. The majority's lack of knowledge ('la ya'lamun') highlights the distinction between mere existence and conscious recognition of divine signs, a key theme in the chapter's call to repentance before the Day of Judgment.
